definition_en: a white mineral substance used to season and preserve food; a chemical compound formed from an acid and a base; to add salt to food
core_image: 一把白色晶体撒在食物上，让味道变咸
scene: 她往汤里加了一点盐。She added a little salt to the soup.
sceneCN: 这里 salt 是「盐、食盐」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她往汤里加了一点盐。

collocations.phrase: take something with a grain of salt

senses.title: The seasoning
senses.definition: a white mineral substance used to season and preserve food
senses.definitionCN: 用于调味和保存食物的白色矿物
senses.example: Please pass the salt.
senses.exampleCN: 请把盐递过来。
senses.why: The everyday sense is the seasoning on the table.
senses.whyCN: 最常见的义项就是餐桌上的调味盐。

senses.title: A chemical salt
senses.definition: a compound formed when an acid reacts with a base
senses.definitionCN: 酸与碱反应生成的化合物
senses.example: The lab tested several salts.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室检测了几种盐类。
senses.why: The seasoning is one member of a large chemical family.
senses.whyCN: 调味盐只是庞大化学盐类家族中的一员。

senses.title: To add salt
senses.definition: to put salt on or in food
senses.definitionCN: 把盐加到食物上或食物里
senses.example: Salt the water before boiling the pasta.
senses.exampleCN: 煮意面前往水里加盐。
senses.why: The verb simply applies the seasoning to food.
senses.whyCN: 动词义就是把调味盐用到食物上。

intro.en: Salt comes from Old English sealt and is related to Latin sal.
intro.cn: salt 源自古英语 sealt，与拉丁语 sal（盐）同源。

items.en: Sealt names the white seasoning.
items.cn: sealt 指白色的调味盐。

items.en: The word is shared across Germanic languages.
items.cn: 这个词在日耳曼语族中广泛共用。

items.en: Latin sal carries the same meaning.
items.cn: 拉丁语 sal 含义相同。

items.en: The spelling settles as salt.
items.cn: 中古英语时期拼写固定为 salt。

items.en: Salt also names a whole class of compounds.
items.cn: 现代英语中 salt 也指一整类化合物。

note.en: Salt is the seasoning; sale is a selling event; sail is a cloth for the wind.
note.cn: salt 是食盐，sale 是出售，sail 是船帆。

entries.definition: a large cloth that catches the wind
something added to food for flavour
the chemical name for common salt
a strong-flavoured substance from a plant

normalIntro.en: Salt is the white seasoning that makes food taste savoury.
normalIntro.cn: salt 是让食物有咸味的白色调味品。

normal.en: Add a pinch of salt to the soup.
normal.cn: 往汤里加一小撮盐。

normal.en: Sea salt is coarser than table salt.
normal.cn: 海盐比食盐颗粒更粗。

normal.en: He salted the meat to keep it fresh.
normal.cn: 他用盐腌肉以保鲜。

normal.en: Too much salt is bad for your blood pressure.
normal.cn: 盐吃太多对血压不好。

normal.en: Take his advice with a grain of salt.
normal.cn: 对他的建议要打个折扣。

abstract.en: Picture white crystals falling onto a hot dish.
abstract.cn: 想象白色晶体落在热菜上。

abstract.en: Imagine the sea leaving salt on the rocks.
abstract.cn: 想象海水在岩石上留下盐。

abstract.en: Think of salt as a tiny key that unlocks flavour.
abstract.cn: 把盐想成一把释放味道的小钥匙。

examples.en: The recipe calls for a teaspoon of salt.
examples.cn: 这个食谱需要一茶匙盐。

examples.en: Salt was once used as money in some cultures.
examples.cn: 在某些文化中盐曾被当作货币。

examples.en: She salted the pasta water generously.
examples.cn: 她在煮意面的水里放了充足的盐。

dict_mnemonic.note: 词源记忆 · 拉丁词根
dict_mnemonic.text: salt 与拉丁语 sal（盐）同源，salary（薪水）原指发给士兵买盐的钱。

root: salt 源自古英语 sealt，与拉丁语 sal（盐）同源；英语 salary 也与「盐」的历史有关。

sensesIntro.en: Salt is the seasoning, a class of chemical compounds, or the act of adding it to food.
sensesIntro.cn: salt 指调味盐、化学盐类，或给食物加盐的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: white crystals that change how food tastes.
core.cn: 核心意象：改变食物味道的白色晶体。

branches.en: The base sense is the seasoning on the table.
branches.cn: 基础义是餐桌上的调味盐。

branches.en: Chemistry extends the name to acid-base compounds.
branches.cn: 化学把这名称扩展到酸碱化合物。

branches.en: The verb applies the seasoning to food.
branches.cn: 动词义把调味盐用到食物上。

branches.en: Common salt is one chemical salt among many.
branches.cn: 食盐只是众多化学盐类之一。

branches.en: Seasoning and salting describe the same kitchen action.
branches.cn: 调味与加盐描述同一个厨房动作。

intro.en: Salt is a short native root that builds several everyday words.
intro.cn: salt 是一个简短的本族词根，能构成多个日常词汇。

latinIntro.en: Latin sal, salis, and salare explain the word family behind salt.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 sal、salis 与 salare 解释了 salt 背后的词族。

items.example: Mineral salts occur in the soil.
The saltiness of the cheese surprised me.
items.exampleCN: 这奶酪的咸度让我惊讶。
海水鱼需要特殊的水族箱。

items.meaning: a small container for table salt
a place where salt is dug out
items.example: They toured an old salt mine.
items.exampleCN: 他们参观了一座旧盐矿。

items.meaning: low coastal land often covered by seawater
items.example: Birds nest in the salt marsh.

latinEntries.example: Sal is the Latin word for salt.
Salis shows the stem used in compounds.
latinEntries.exampleCN: salis 展示了复合词中使用的词干。

latinEntries.example: Salare means to treat with salt.

definition_en: exactly alike or not different; the very one already mentioned or known; unchanged from before
core_image: 两件物品并排放置，看不出任何差别
scene: 我们穿同样的鞋。We wear the same shoes.
sceneCN: 这里 same 是「相同的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：我们穿同样的鞋。

forms.label: 无比较级与最高级（本身已表相同）

senses.title: Exactly alike
senses.definition: exactly alike in kind, amount, or quality
senses.definitionCN: 在种类、数量或质量上完全一样
senses.example: We chose the same colour.
senses.exampleCN: 我们选了同样的颜色。
senses.why: The base sense is simple equality between things.
senses.whyCN: 基础义就是事物之间的简单相等。

senses.title: The very one
senses.definition: the particular one already mentioned, not a different one
senses.definitionCN: 已经提到的那个特定的，而不是另一个
senses.example: This is the same man I saw yesterday.
senses.exampleCN: 这就是我昨天看见的那个人。
senses.why: Identity is stronger than similarity: it is one thing, not two.
senses.whyCN: 同一性强于相似性：它是同一个而不是两个。

senses.title: Unchanged
senses.definition: staying in the same condition as before
senses.definitionCN: 保持与以前相同的状况
senses.example: The town looks the same after ten years.
senses.exampleCN: 十年过去，这个镇子看上去依旧。
senses.why: The idea of no difference extends from things to time.
senses.whyCN: 「没有差别」从事物延伸到时间。

intro.en: Same comes from Old Norse samr, which replaced an older English word.
intro.cn: same 来自古诺尔斯语 samr，取代了更早的英语词。

items.en: A shared root means together or alike.
items.cn: 共同的词根意为「一起」或「相似」。

items.en: Samr means same or together.
items.cn: samr 意为相同的或一起的。

items.en: The native word ilca covers the meaning.
items.cn: 本族词 ilca 承担这一含义。

items.en: Same enters English from Norse influence.
items.cn: 受诺尔斯语影响，same 进入英语。

items.en: The same as becomes a fixed comparison.
items.cn: the same as 成为固定比较结构。

note.en: Same means not different; some means an unspecified amount.
note.cn: same 是「相同」，some 是「一些」。

entries.definition: the same in size or value

normalIntro.en: Same often appears with the: the same as, the same time.
normalIntro.cn: same 常与 the 连用：the same as、the same time。

normal.en: We are in the same class.
normal.cn: 我们在同一个班。

normal.en: Her answer was the same as mine.
normal.cn: 她的答案和我的一样。

normal.en: They left at the same time.
normal.cn: 他们同时离开。

normal.en: He said the same thing twice.
normal.cn: 他把同一件事说了两遍。

normal.en: Thanks, same to you.
normal.cn: 谢谢，也同样祝福你。

abstract.en: Picture two cups made from one mould.
abstract.cn: 想象两个用同一模具做出的杯子。

abstract.en: Imagine a photo printed twice without change.
abstract.cn: 想象一张照片原样印了两份。

abstract.en: Think of a clock still showing the old time.
abstract.cn: 想象时钟仍停在原来的时间。

examples.en: Do you two take the same bus?
examples.cn: 你们俩坐同一路公交车吗？

examples.en: The result was the same as last year.
examples.cn: 结果和去年一样。

examples.en: All the same, I think we should try.
examples.cn: 尽管如此，我认为我们应该试一试。

dict_mnemonic.note: 搭配记忆 · 定冠词 the
dict_mnemonic.text: same 几乎总与 the 连用，记住 the same as（与…相同）和 at the same time（同时）。

root: same 源自古诺尔斯语 samr，与「一起、相同」的日耳曼词根有关，后取代本族词 ilca。

sensesIntro.en: Same means alike, the very one, or unchanged over time.
sensesIntro.cn: same 表示相同、同一，或随时间保持不变。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two things with no visible difference.
core.cn: 核心意象：看不出差别的两样东西。

branches.en: The base sense is equality between things.
branches.cn: 基础义是事物之间的相等。

branches.en: Identity means it is one thing, not two.
branches.cn: 同一性意味着是同一个而非两个。

branches.en: No difference extends across time.
branches.cn: 「无差别」延伸到时间维度。

branches.en: Alike things may or may not be the same one.
branches.cn: 相像的事物未必是同一个。

branches.en: The same person can stay unchanged for years.
branches.cn: 同一个人可以多年保持不变。

intro.en: Same rarely takes prefixes but forms a few common compounds.
intro.cn: same 很少加前缀，但能构成一些常见复合词。

latinIntro.en: Same has no Latin root; its history is Germanic and Norse.
latinIntro.cn: same 没有拉丁词根，其历史属于日耳曼语与诺尔斯语。

items.example: The sameness of the houses bored her.
items.exampleCN: 千篇一律的房子让她厌倦。
这项法律涵盖同性伴侣。

items.example: It rained, but we went all the same.
items.exampleCN: 下雨了，但我们还是去了。

items.example: My bag is the same as yours.

definition_zh: 样本；样品；试样；抽样；品尝
definition_en: a small part that shows what the whole is like; a specimen taken for testing; to take or try a small part of something
core_image: 从一整批货中取出一小份，用来代表全部
scene: 医生取了血液样本做检查。The doctor took a blood sample for testing.
sceneCN: 这里 sample 是「样本、试样」（第 2 个义项）；句意：医生取了血液样本做检查。

senses.title: A small representative part
senses.definition: a small part of something that shows what the whole is like
senses.definitionCN: 能代表整体状况的一小部分
senses.example: The shop gives free samples of the tea.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店免费提供茶叶样品。
senses.why: The core sense is a part standing for the whole.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是用部分代表整体。

senses.title: A specimen for testing
senses.definition: a small amount of a substance taken for scientific testing
senses.definitionCN: 为科学检测而取的一小份物质
senses.example: The lab analysed the water sample.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室分析了水样。
senses.why: The representative part is taken specifically for analysis.
senses.whyCN: 代表性的一小份被专门取出用于分析。

senses.title: To take or try a part
senses.definition: to take a small part of something, or to try a little of it
senses.definitionCN: 取一小部分，或少量尝试
senses.example: You can sample three dishes at the buffet.
senses.exampleCN: 自助餐上你可以品尝三道菜。
senses.why: The verb turns the small part into an action.
senses.whyCN: 动词义把「取一小份」变成动作。

intro.en: Sample comes from Old French essample, from Latin exemplum.
intro.cn: sample 来自古法语 essample，源头是拉丁语 exemplum。

items.en: Exemplum means a copy or example.
items.cn: exemplum 意为副本或范例。

items.en: Essample carries the sense of a model.
items.cn: essample 带有「范本」之义。

items.en: The first syllable drops, giving sample.
items.cn: 首音节脱落，形成 sample。

items.en: Sample names goods shown to buyers.
items.cn: 早期现代英语中 sample 指给买家的货样。

items.en: Science adopts sample for tested specimens.
items.cn: 科学领域用 sample 指待检试样。

note.en: A sample represents a whole; a simple thing is easy to understand.
note.cn: sample 是代表整体的样本，simple 则是简单的。

entries.definition: a comparison using like or as
a thing that shows a general rule
a small copy or a typical pattern

normalIntro.en: A sample is a small piece that speaks for the whole.
normalIntro.cn: sample 是代表整体的那一小份。

normal.en: They handed out samples at the supermarket.
normal.cn: 他们在超市分发样品。

normal.en: The nurse took a blood sample.
normal.cn: 护士采了血样。

normal.en: We sampled the local food.
normal.cn: 我们品尝了当地食物。

normal.en: A random sample reduces bias.
normal.cn: 随机抽样能减少偏差。

normal.en: The sample size was too small.
normal.cn: 样本量太小了。

abstract.en: Picture one spoonful taken from a large pot.
abstract.cn: 想象从一大锅里舀出一勺。

abstract.en: Imagine a fabric swatch showing the whole cloth.
abstract.cn: 想象一块布样代表整匹布。

abstract.en: Think of a taste as a tiny preview of a meal.
abstract.cn: 把一口品尝想成整顿饭的微缩预览。

examples.en: Please send us a sample of the fabric.
examples.cn: 请给我们寄一份布料样品。

examples.en: The survey used a sample of one thousand adults.
examples.cn: 这项调查抽取了一千名成年人作为样本。

examples.en: Visitors can sample local cheeses.
examples.cn: 游客可以品尝当地奶酪。

dict_mnemonic.note: 词源记忆 · 拉丁词根
dict_mnemonic.text: sample 是 example 的姊妹词，都源于拉丁语 exemplum（范例），记住「取一份作范例」。

root: sample 经由古法语 essample 来自拉丁语 exemplum（范例、样本），首音节脱落形成现代拼写。

sensesIntro.en: Sample is a representative part, a tested specimen, or the act of trying a small amount.
sensesIntro.cn: sample 指代表性样本、检测用试样，或少量尝试的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one small part standing for the whole.
core.cn: 核心意象：以一小部分代表整体。

branches.en: The base sense is a part that represents the whole.
branches.cn: 基础义是代表整体的一部分。

branches.en: Science takes a specimen for analysis.
branches.cn: 科学取试样进行分析。

branches.en: The verb turns sampling into an action.
branches.cn: 动词义把取样变成动作。

branches.en: Shops let buyers sample what they sell.
branches.cn: 商店让买家试用所售之物。

branches.en: Testing and tasting both use a small part.
branches.cn: 检测与品尝都只取一小部分。

intro.en: Sample forms a compact family around taking or showing a small part.
intro.cn: sample 围绕「取一小份或展示一小份」形成紧凑词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin exemplum and its relatives lie behind sample and example.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 exemplum 及其同族词是 sample 与 example 的源头。

items.meaning: a small part or to try one

items.exampleCN: 实验室收到了三个样本。

items.meaning: a person or device that samples
items.example: The air sampler ran all night.
We need to resample the soil.
items.exampleCN: 我们需要重新采集土壤样本。

items.meaning: a sample drawn from a sample
items.example: They drew a subsample for review.
items.exampleCN: 他们抽取子样本进行复核。

items.meaning: a survey of a selected group
items.example: The sample survey covered five cities.
items.exampleCN: 这项抽样调查覆盖了五个城市。

latinEntries.example: Exemplum is the source of sample.
latinEntries.exampleCN: exemplum 是 sample 的源头。
exemplaris 是 exemplary 的前身。

definition_en: tiny loose grains of worn rock; an area of this material, especially a beach; to smooth or polish with sand or sandpaper
core_image: 无数细小石粒从指缝间流下
scene: 孩子们在沙滩上玩沙子。The children played in the sand on the beach.
sceneCN: 这里 sand 是「沙、沙子」（第 1 个义项）；句意：孩子们在沙滩上玩沙子。

collocations.phrase: bury one's head in the sand

senses.title: Loose grains
senses.definition: tiny loose grains formed from worn rock
senses.definitionCN: 由风化岩石形成的细小松散颗粒
senses.example: The wind blew sand into my eyes.
senses.exampleCN: 风把沙子吹进了我的眼睛。
senses.why: The base sense is the material itself.
senses.whyCN: 基础义就是这种物质本身。

senses.title: A sandy shore
senses.definition: a large area covered with sand, especially beside the sea
senses.definitionCN: 大片覆沙之地，尤指海边
senses.example: We walked for miles along the sands.
senses.exampleCN: 我们沿着沙滩走了好几英里。
senses.why: The material names the place it covers.
senses.whyCN: 这种物质用它覆盖的地方来命名。

senses.title: To smooth with sand
senses.definition: to smooth or polish a surface with sand or sandpaper
senses.definitionCN: 用砂或砂纸使表面光滑
senses.example: He sanded the table before painting it.
senses.exampleCN: 他刷漆前把桌子打磨了一遍。
senses.why: The verb uses the gritty material as a tool.
senses.whyCN: 动词义把这种颗粒材料当作工具。

intro.en: Sand comes from Old English sand, a word shared across Germanic languages.
intro.cn: sand 源自古英语 sand，是日耳曼语族共有的词。

items.en: A common root names loose ground.
items.cn: 共同的词根指松散的地面。

items.en: Sand names the grains and the shore.
items.cn: sand 指沙粒与沙岸。

items.en: Arena means sand and gives English arena.
items.cn: 拉丁语 arena 意为沙，并演变为英语 arena。

items.en: The plural sands names wide beaches.
items.cn: 中古英语复数 sands 指广阔沙滩。

items.en: The verb develops with sandpaper.
items.cn: 随着砂纸的出现，动词义逐渐形成。

note.en: Sand is fine grains; send means to make something go.
note.cn: sand 是细沙，send 则是寄送。

entries.definition: to cause something to go somewhere

normalIntro.en: Sand is the fine material that makes beaches and dunes.
normalIntro.cn: sand 是构成沙滩与沙丘的细小物质。

normal.en: Sand got into my shoes.
normal.cn: 沙子进了我的鞋里。

normal.en: The children built a sand castle.
normal.cn: 孩子们堆了一座沙堡。

normal.en: Camels cross the desert sands.
normal.cn: 骆驼穿越沙漠。

normal.en: He sanded the wood until it was smooth.
normal.cn: 他把木头打磨到光滑。

normal.en: Do not bury your head in the sand.
normal.cn: 不要逃避现实。

abstract.en: Picture a handful of grains slipping through your fingers.
abstract.cn: 想象一把细沙从指缝流走。

abstract.en: Imagine waves smoothing a wide beach.
abstract.cn: 想象海浪抚平宽阔的沙滩。

abstract.en: Think of paper rough with tiny sharp grains.
abstract.cn: 想象布满细小尖颗粒的粗糙纸张。

examples.en: The path was covered with fine sand.
examples.cn: 小路上铺着细沙。

examples.en: We sat on the warm sand and watched the sea.
examples.cn: 我们坐在温暖的沙滩上看海。

examples.en: She sanded the old door before painting it.
examples.cn: 她在刷漆前把旧门打磨了一遍。

dict_mnemonic.note: 词源记忆 · 拉丁同义词
dict_mnemonic.text: sand 是日耳曼本族词，而拉丁语 arena（沙）进入了英语，成为竞技场 arena 的来源。

root: sand 源自古英语 sand，属日耳曼语族；拉丁语中表示沙的 arena 则演变为英语 arena。

sensesIntro.en: Sand is the fine grains, a sandy shore, or the act of smoothing with sand.
sensesIntro.cn: sand 指细沙、沙滩沙地，或用砂打磨的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: countless tiny grains slipping through the fingers.
core.cn: 核心意象：无数细粒从指间流走。

branches.en: The base sense is the loose material.
branches.cn: 基础义是松散的沙粒。

branches.en: The material names the shore it covers.
branches.cn: 这种物质命名了它覆盖的沙岸。

branches.en: The verb uses grit to smooth a surface.
branches.cn: 动词义用砂粒磨平表面。

branches.en: Beaches are simply wide fields of sand.

senses.definition: to meet a rule, condition, or standard
senses.definitionCN: 达到规则、条件或标准
senses.example: The team must satisfy the entry rules.
senses.exampleCN: 这支队伍必须符合参赛规则。
senses.why: The idea of enough applies to formal conditions.
senses.whyCN: 「足够」的观念适用于正式条件。

senses.title: To convince
senses.definition: to give someone enough proof to remove doubt
senses.definitionCN: 提供足以消除疑问的证据
senses.example: The evidence satisfied the jury.
senses.exampleCN: 证据使陪审团信服了。
senses.why: Proof fills the space of doubt until nothing is left to question.
senses.whyCN: 证据填满疑问的空间，直到无可质疑。

intro.en: Satisfy comes from Latin satisfacere, from satis enough and facere to make.
intro.cn: satisfy 来自拉丁语 satisfacere，由 satis（足够）与 facere（做）构成。

items.en: Satis means enough.
items.cn: satis 意为足够。

items.en: Facere means to make or do.
items.cn: facere 意为做。

items.en: Satisfacere means to make enough.
items.cn: satisfacere 意为做到足够。

items.en: Satisfier carries the sense of paying a debt.
items.cn: satisfier 带有偿还债务之义。

items.en: Satisfy means to please, fulfil, or convince.
items.cn: 现代英语中 satisfy 意为使满意、满足或使信服。

note.en: Satisfy means to give enough; satiate means to fill to excess.
note.cn: satisfy 是给足，satiate 则是过度填满。

entries.definition: to fill beyond what is wanted
to satisfy fully, often too much
to carry out a need or promise

normalIntro.en: Satisfy works for people, needs, rules, and doubts alike.
normalIntro.cn: satisfy 的对象可以是人、需要、规则或疑问。

normal.en: The answer did not satisfy the teacher.
normal.cn: 这个答案没能让老师满意。

normal.en: He ate bread to satisfy his hunger.
normal.cn: 他吃面包充饥。

normal.en: The product satisfies all safety standards.
normal.cn: 该产品符合所有安全标准。

normal.en: She satisfied the judges that she was right.
normal.cn: 她使评委相信她是对的。

normal.en: Are you satisfied with the service?
normal.cn: 你对服务满意吗？

abstract.en: Picture a cup filled exactly to the right level.
abstract.cn: 想象杯子被倒到恰到好处的高度。

abstract.en: Imagine a lock clicking shut on the last number.
abstract.cn: 想象密码锁在最后一个数字咔哒合上。

abstract.en: Think of doubt melting once proof arrives.
abstract.cn: 想象证据到来后疑问随之消融。

examples.en: It is impossible to satisfy everyone.
examples.cn: 不可能让所有人都满意。

examples.en: The meal satisfied our appetite.
examples.cn: 这顿饭满足了我们的胃口。

examples.en: Candidates must satisfy the language requirement.
examples.cn: 考生必须符合语言要求。

dict_mnemonic.note: 词源记忆 · 拉丁组合
dict_mnemonic.text: satis（足够）+ fy（使…）= satisfy（使足够、使满足），同族词还有 satisfaction 与 satisfactory。

root: satisfy 源自拉丁语 satisfacere，由 satis（足够）与 facere（做）构成，意为「做到足够」。

sensesIntro.en: Satisfy means to please, fulfil a need, meet a standard, or convince.
sensesIntro.cn: satisfy 意为使满意、满足需要、符合标准，或使信服。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: giving exactly enough to fill a need.
core.cn: 核心意象：给出恰好的量来填满需要。

branches.en: The base sense is making someone pleased.
branches.cn: 基础义是使某人高兴。

branches.en: A need is an empty space to fill.
branches.cn: 需要是一个待填满的空缺。

branches.en: Rules define what counts as enough.
branches.cn: 规则界定何为足够。

branches.en: Proof fills the space of doubt.
branches.cn: 证据填满疑问的空间。

branches.en: Pleasing someone often means meeting their need.
branches.cn: 让人满意常常意味着满足其需要。

intro.en: Satisfy is the verb at the centre of the satisf- family.
intro.cn: satisfy 是 satisf- 词族的核心动词。

latinIntro.en: Latin satis and facere combine into satisfacere, the source of satisfy.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 satis 与 facere 组合成 satisfacere，即 satisfy 的源头。

items.meaning: to give enough and make content

items.exampleCN: 这个计划符合每个条件。

items.meaning: pleased or having met a need
items.example: We are satisfied with the answer.

items.exampleCN: 这是一次令人满足的经历。
许多需求仍未得到满足。

latinEntries.example: Satis is the first element of satisfy.
latinEntries.exampleCN: satis 是 satisfy 的第一个成分。
facere 在英语动词中变成 -fy。

latinEntries.example: Satisfacere is the direct source of satisfy.
latinEntries.exampleCN: satisfacere 是 satisfy 的直接源头。
satisfactus 是 satisfied 的前身。

definition_en: a thick liquid served with food to add flavour
core_image: 一勺浓稠的番茄酱浇在热气腾腾的意大利面上
scene: 厨房里，妈妈把酱汁浇在面条上。Mom poured the sauce over the noodles.
sceneCN: 这里 sauce 是「调味汁」（第 1 个义项）；句意：妈妈把酱汁浇在了面条上。

senses.title: Flavoured liquid
senses.definition: a thick liquid served with food to add flavour
senses.definitionCN: 与食物一起食用、用来增添风味的浓稠液体
senses.example: She made a rich tomato sauce for the pasta.
senses.exampleCN: 她为意面做了一份浓郁的番茄酱。
senses.why: The basic sense is a liquid that flavours food.
senses.whyCN: 基本义是给食物增添风味的液体。

senses.title: Cooking juices
senses.definition: the juice that comes from meat while it is cooking
senses.definitionCN: 肉在烹制过程中流出的汁液
senses.example: The roast beef was served with its own sauce.
senses.exampleCN: 烤牛肉配着它自身的肉汁一起上桌。
senses.why: Natural cooking juices work like a sauce.
senses.whyCN: 烹制时流出的天然汁液起着酱汁的作用。

senses.title: Audacity
senses.definition: rude or cheeky behaviour, used informally
senses.definitionCN: 非正式用语，指无礼或冒失的行为
senses.example: Nobody has the sauce to argue with her.
senses.exampleCN: 没人敢冒失地跟她争辩。
senses.why: The flavour image shifts to a bold and sharp manner.
senses.whyCN: 从味道的形象引申为大胆而带刺的态度。

intro.en: Sauce comes from Latin salsus, meaning salted, through Old French.
intro.cn: sauce 源自拉丁语 salsus（盐腌的），经古法语进入英语。

items.en: Salsus means salted, from sal, salt.
items.cn: salsus 意为盐腌的，来自 sal（盐）。

items.en: Salsa meant a salted or seasoned preparation.
items.cn: salsa 指盐腌或调味的食物。

items.en: Sauce named a seasoned liquid served with food.
items.cn: sauce 在古法语中指配食物的调味液体。

items.en: English borrowed sauce for liquid served with meat.
items.cn: 中古英语借入 sauce，指配肉食的液态调料。

items.en: Sauce now covers sweet, savoury, and figurative uses.
items.cn: 现代英语中 sauce 兼指甜酱、咸酱与引申义。

note.en: Sauce is compared with look-alike words and with other things served alongside food.
note.cn: 把 sauce 与形近词以及佐餐调料作比较。

entries.definition: a small shallow dish for a cup
a room filled with hot steam for bathing
to soak food in salty water

normalIntro.en: Sauce can be remembered by sound, image, and word family.
normalIntro.cn: 可以从读音、画面和词族三个角度记住 sauce。

normal.en: Think of sauce as the source of flavour on the plate.
normal.cn: 把 sauce 想成盘子里风味的来源，即 source。

normal.en: The round au in sauce looks like a drop of gravy.
normal.cn: sauce 中圆圆的 au 像一滴酱汁。

normal.en: Soy sauce and tomato sauce are two everyday examples.
normal.cn: 酱油和番茄酱是两个日常例子。

normal.en: Saucy means cheeky, just as sauce can mean audacity.
normal.cn: saucy 意为俏皮无礼，正如 sauce 可指冒失。

normal.en: The plural sauces simply adds s to the base word.
normal.cn: 复数 sauces 只需在词尾加 s。

abstract.en: Sauce is the seasoning that turns plain food into a treat.
abstract.cn: 酱汁是把普通食物变成美味的调味。

abstract.en: A little sauce can change the whole mood of a meal.
abstract.cn: 一点酱汁就能改变整顿饭的气氛。

abstract.en: Sauce hides neither the food nor itself; it blends both.
abstract.cn: 酱汁既不掩盖食物也不掩盖自己，而是让两者融合。

examples.en: The chef added a spoonful of sauce to the rice.
examples.cn: 厨师往米饭里加了一勺酱汁。

examples.en: Too much sauce can hide the taste of the fish.
examples.cn: 酱汁太多会盖住鱼的味道。

examples.en: She stirred the sauce slowly over low heat.
examples.cn: 她在小火上慢慢搅动酱汁。

dict_mnemonic.text: sauce 与 salt（盐）同源，最初指盐腌调味的液体，可记「一勺带咸香的酱汁」。

root: 源自拉丁语 salsus（盐腌的），经古法语 sauce 进入英语，核心义「加盐调味、配食物食用的液体」。

sensesIntro.en: Sauce means a flavoured liquid for food, natural cooking juices, or informally audacity.
sensesIntro.cn: sauce 意为给食物调味的液体、天然肉汁，或口语中的冒失无礼。

core.en: A seasoned liquid that adds flavour to food.
core.cn: 给食物增添风味的调味液体。

branches.en: The core sense, a flavoured liquid served with a dish.
branches.cn: 核心义，配菜食用的调味液体。

branches.en: Natural meat juices used as a sauce.
branches.cn: 用作酱汁的天然肉汁。

branches.en: Boldness, from spicy flavour to a sharp manner.
branches.cn: 由辛辣味道引申出的冒失态度。

branches.en: Everyday cooking links poured sauce and natural juices.
branches.cn: 日常烹饪把浇上的酱汁和天然肉汁联系起来。

branches.en: Rich juice and bold manner both suggest strength.
branches.cn: 浓郁的肉汁与大胆的态度都暗示强烈。

intro.en: Sauce belongs to a family of cooking and manner words.
intro.cn: sauce 属于一个兼指烹饪与态度的词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin salsus, salted, is the distant source of sauce.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 salsus（盐腌的）是 sauce 的远源。

items.meaning: a deep pan with a long handle
items.example: Boil the water in a saucepan.

items.meaning: a rich egg and butter sauce

items.exampleCN: 他们用薯片蘸萨尔萨酱。

latinEntries.example: Sal is the root of salsus.
latinEntries.exampleCN: sal 是 salsus 的词根。

definition_en: finely chopped meat packed into a thin casing
core_image: 平底锅里几根香肠滋滋作响，表皮变成金棕色
scene: 早餐时，平底锅里煎着几根香肠。Two sausages are frying in the pan.
sceneCN: 这里 sausage 是「香肠」（第 1 个义项）；句意：两根香肠正在锅里煎着。

senses.title: Meat in a casing
senses.definition: finely chopped meat packed into a thin casing
senses.definitionCN: 切碎后灌入细肠衣的肉
senses.example: They grilled sausages for lunch.
senses.exampleCN: 他们午餐烤了香肠。
senses.why: The core sense is chopped meat shaped by a casing.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是用肠衣定型的碎肉。

senses.title: Processed sausage product
senses.definition: a manufactured meat product sold in a sausage shape
senses.definitionCN: 做成香肠形状出售的加工肉制品
senses.example: He bought a packet of sausage snacks.
senses.exampleCN: 他买了一包香肠零食。
senses.why: The casing shape extends to industrial meat products.
senses.whyCN: 肠衣的形状扩展到工业肉制品。

senses.title: Sausage shape
senses.definition: something long and rounded like a sausage
senses.definitionCN: 像香肠一样细长而圆的东西
senses.example: The balloon was twisted into a sausage shape.
senses.exampleCN: 气球被扭成了香肠的形状。
senses.why: The food shape becomes a way to describe other objects.
senses.whyCN: 食物形状成为描述其他物体的方式。

intro.en: Sausage traces from Latin salsus through Late Latin salsicia and Old French.
intro.cn: sausage 经晚期拉丁语 salsicia 和古法语，追溯到拉丁语 salsus。

items.en: Salsus means salted.
items.cn: salsus 意为盐腌的。

items.en: Salsicia named salted meat preparations.
items.cn: salsicia 指盐腌的肉类食品。

items.en: Saussiche named a seasoned meat casing.
items.cn: saussiche 指调味肉肠。

items.en: Sausige appeared for minced meat in a skin.
items.cn: sausige 指灌在肠衣中的碎肉。

items.en: Sausage covers fresh, cured, and industrial products.
items.cn: 现代英语中 sausage 兼指鲜肠、腊肠和工业制品。

note.en: Sausage is compared with look-alike words and other meat products.
note.cn: 把 sausage 与形近词和其他肉制品作比较。

entries.definition: a small dish under a cup
a sausage served in a long bun

normalIntro.en: Sausage can be remembered by its salt root and its shape.
normalIntro.cn: 可以从盐腌词根和细长形状两方面记住 sausage。

normal.en: Sausage begins like sauce, because both come from salted food.
normal.cn: sausage 开头像 sauce，因为两者都源自盐腌食物。

normal.en: The long body of the word looks like a sausage link.
normal.cn: 这个单词长长的词形像一截香肠。

normal.en: Sausages are often fried, so picture them in a hot pan.
normal.cn: 香肠常被煎，想象它们在热锅里。

normal.en: A sausage roll wraps the meat in pastry.
normal.cn: 香肠卷把肉包在酥皮里。

normal.en: The plural sausages adds s and keeps the soft ge sound.
normal.cn: 复数 sausages 加 s，并保留柔和的 ge 音。

abstract.en: A casing turns scattered meat into one neat form.
abstract.cn: 肠衣把零散的肉变成一个整齐的整体。

abstract.en: Salt once preserved meat through long winters.
abstract.cn: 盐曾经帮助人们在漫长冬季保存肉类。

abstract.en: The sausage shape is simple enough to describe almost anything.
abstract.cn: 香肠的形状简单到几乎可以形容任何东西。

examples.en: She sliced the sausage for the pasta.
examples.cn: 她把香肠切片放进意面。

examples.en: The smell of fried sausage filled the kitchen.
examples.cn: 煎香肠的香味充满了厨房。

examples.en: He ate a sausage roll on the train.
examples.cn: 他在火车上吃了一个香肠卷。

dict_mnemonic.text: sausage 与 sauce 同源，都和盐腌有关，可记「用盐腌好、灌进肠衣的肉」。

root: 源自拉丁语 salsus（盐腌的），经晚期拉丁语 salsicia 与古法语 saussiche 进入英语，核心义「盐腌碎肉灌成的肠」。

sensesIntro.en: Sausage means chopped meat in a casing, a processed meat product, or a sausage shape.
sensesIntro.cn: sausage 意为灌在肠衣里的碎肉、加工肉制品，或香肠形状。

core.en: Salted chopped meat shaped inside a casing.
core.cn: 在肠衣中定型的盐腌碎肉。

branches.en: The core food, meat packed in a casing.
branches.cn: 核心食物，灌入肠衣的肉。

branches.en: Manufactured meat products in sausage form.
branches.cn: 做成香肠形状的加工肉制品。

branches.en: Any object with a long rounded shape.
branches.cn: 任何细长浑圆的物体。

branches.en: Both are meat sold in a casing or tube.
branches.cn: 两者都是肠衣或管状包装出售的肉。

branches.en: The industrial product keeps the food shape.
branches.cn: 工业制品保留了食物的形状。

intro.en: Sausage belongs to the salted-food family of sauce.
intro.cn: sausage 属于 sauce 的盐腌食物词族。

latinIntro.en: The root is Latin salsus, salted.
latinIntro.cn: 其词根是拉丁语 salsus（盐腌的）。

items.example: Mix the sausage meat with herbs.
items.exampleCN: 把香肠肉馅和香草拌在一起。

items.example: His saucy joke made us laugh.
items.exampleCN: 他俏皮的笑话逗笑了我们。
萨尔萨辣酱配薯片很好。

latinEntries.example: Sal is the Latin word for salt.

definition_en: to keep safe from harm, to use less, or to put money aside
core_image: 救生员跃入泳池，把孩子托出水面
scene: 泳池边，救生员跳入水中救起孩子。The lifeguard saved the child from drowning.
sceneCN: 这里 save 是「挽救」（第 1 个义项）；句意：救生员把孩子从溺水中救了出来。

senses.title: Rescue from harm
senses.definition: to keep someone or something safe from danger or harm
senses.definitionCN: 使某人或某物免于危险或伤害
senses.example: The doctor saved the boy's life.
senses.exampleCN: 医生救了男孩的命。
senses.why: The oldest sense is bringing someone out of danger.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项是把人从危险中带出来。

senses.title: Use less
senses.definition: to avoid wasting money, time, or resources
senses.definitionCN: 避免浪费金钱、时间或资源
senses.example: Taking the train saves time.
senses.exampleCN: 坐火车能节省时间。
senses.why: Rescuing a resource from waste becomes saving it.
senses.whyCN: 把资源从浪费中救出，就变成节省。

senses.title: Put money aside
senses.definition: to keep money for future use
senses.definitionCN: 把钱留作将来使用
senses.example: She saves a little every month.
senses.exampleCN: 她每月存一点钱。
senses.why: Money kept safe for later is money saved.
senses.whyCN: 为以后安全留存的钱就是储蓄。

senses.title: Store a file
senses.definition: to store work in a computer so it can be used later
senses.definitionCN: 把工作内容存入电脑以便以后使用
senses.example: Remember to save the document.
senses.exampleCN: 记得保存文档。
senses.why: Digital storage keeps work safe from loss.
senses.whyCN: 数字存储让工作成果免于丢失。

senses.title: Spare someone
senses.definition: to prevent someone from having to do something unpleasant
senses.definitionCN: 使某人不必做不愉快的事
senses.example: I will save you the trouble.
senses.exampleCN: 我会省去你的麻烦。
senses.why: Spared effort is effort saved.
senses.whyCN: 省去的力气就是被节省的力气。

intro.en: Save comes from Latin salvare, to make safe, through Old French sauver.
intro.cn: save 经古法语 sauver，源自拉丁语 salvare（使安全）。

items.en: Salvare means to make safe or to rescue.
items.cn: salvare 意为使安全或拯救。

items.en: Salvus means safe and uninjured.
items.cn: salvus 意为安全无恙的。

items.en: Sauver carried the sense of rescuing and sparing.
items.cn: sauver 兼具拯救与省下之义。

items.en: Saven added the sense of keeping money.
items.cn: saven 增加了存钱的含义。

items.en: Save extends to time, files, and effort.
items.cn: 现代英语中 save 扩展到时间、文件和精力。

note.en: Save is compared with similar spellings and with words for rescuing or keeping.
note.cn: 把 save 与形近词以及表示拯救或保留的词作比较。

entries.definition: to keep something in good condition

normalIntro.en: Save can be remembered through its sense of keeping safe.
normalIntro.cn: 可以通过「保持安全」这一核心意思记住 save。

normal.en: Save and safe share the same opening sound and meaning.
normal.cn: save 与 safe 开头音相同，意思也相通。

normal.en: Saving money keeps it safe for another day.
normal.cn: 存钱就是把钱安全留到以后用。

normal.en: A lifeguard saves a swimmer, while a saver saves cash.
normal.cn: 救生员救人，储蓄者存钱，都是 save。

normal.en: Press save before closing the document.
normal.cn: 关闭文档前按下保存键。

normal.en: The past form saved is made by adding d.
normal.cn: 过去式 saved 只需在词尾加 d。

abstract.en: To save is to give something a second chance.
abstract.cn: 拯救就是给某物第二次机会。

abstract.en: Every saved minute is a minute returned to you.
abstract.cn: 每一分钟节省下来的时间都是还给你的时间。

abstract.en: Saving links the present self with the future self.
abstract.cn: 储蓄把现在的自己与未来的自己连接起来。

examples.en: The new system saves the company a lot of money.
examples.cn: 新系统为公司节省了大量资金。

examples.en: He saved enough to buy a small car.
examples.cn: 他攒够了钱买一辆小车。

examples.en: Please save your work before the computer restarts.
examples.cn: 电脑重启前请保存你的工作。

dict_mnemonic.text: save 与 safe（安全的）同源，核心是「使安全」：救人、省资源、存钱、存文件都是让东西不丢失。

root: 源自拉丁语 salvare（使安全），与 salvus（安全的）同源，核心义「使免于损失或危险」。

sensesIntro.en: Save means to rescue, to use less, to put money aside, to store a file, or to spare someone trouble.
sensesIntro.cn: save 意为拯救、节省、储蓄、保存文件，或省去某人的麻烦。

core.en: To keep someone or something safe from loss.
core.cn: 使某人或某物免于损失。

branches.en: The core act of rescuing from harm.
branches.cn: 从危险中救出的核心行为。

branches.en: Resources kept from being wasted.
branches.cn: 使资源免于浪费。

branches.en: Money kept safe for future needs.
branches.cn: 为将来需要而安全保留的钱。

branches.en: Computer work stored against loss.
branches.cn: 防止丢失而存储的电脑成果。

branches.en: Trouble removed from someone.
branches.cn: 为某人省去的麻烦。

intro.en: Save has a broad family built on the idea of safety.
intro.cn: save 有一个围绕「安全」概念扩展的大家族。

latinIntro.en: Latin salvare and salvus lie behind the English family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 salvare 与 salvus 是这一英语词族的来源。

items.meaning: a person or thing that saves

items.example: The change gave us a saving of ten pounds.
items.exampleCN: 这一改动让我们省了十英镑。

items.example: Her savings are in the bank.

definition_en: to speak words, to express something, or to give a stated meaning
core_image: 会议上一个人举起手，准备说出自己的看法
scene: 会议上，他举手要求发言。He raised his hand to say something.
sceneCN: 这里 say 是「说」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他举手想说点什么。

senses.title: Speak words
senses.definition: to speak words in order to express something
senses.definitionCN: 说出话语以表达某事
senses.example: She said she would come later.
senses.exampleCN: 她说她会晚点来。
senses.why: The basic sense is producing speech.
senses.whyCN: 基本义是发出话语。

senses.title: Show in writing
senses.definition: of a sign or text, to show or state something
senses.definitionCN: 指标牌或文字显示、写明某事
senses.example: The notice says the shop is closed.
senses.exampleCN: 告示上写着商店关门。
senses.why: Written words speak to the reader.
senses.whyCN: 书面文字也在向读者说话。

senses.title: For example
senses.definition: used to introduce an example or an approximate amount
senses.definitionCN: 用于引出例子或大概的数量
senses.example: Take an apple, say, and cut it in half.
senses.exampleCN: 比如说拿一个苹果，把它切成两半。
senses.why: The speaker says a possible case aloud.
senses.whyCN: 说话者把一种可能情况说出来。

senses.title: Right to speak
senses.definition: the chance or right to express an opinion
senses.definitionCN: 表达意见的机会或权利
senses.example: Everyone should have a say in the plan.
senses.exampleCN: 每个人都应对这个计划有发言权。
senses.why: The act of saying becomes the right to be heard.
senses.whyCN: 说的行为转化为被倾听的权利。

intro.en: Say is a native English word from Old English secgan, with Germanic roots.
intro.cn: say 是英语本族词，源自古英语 secgan，属于日耳曼语源。

items.en: Sagjan meant to tell or to state.
items.cn: sagjan 意为讲述或陈述。

items.en: Secgan meant to say or to tell.
items.cn: secgan 意为说或告诉。

items.en: Seien simplified the spelling and kept the sound.
items.cn: seien 简化了拼写并保留读音。

items.en: Say became the standard form for speaking.
items.cn: say 成为表示说话的标准形式。

items.en: Fixed phrases such as needless to say grew common.
items.cn: needless to say 等固定短语逐渐常见。

note.en: Say is compared with look-alike spellings and with other speech verbs.
note.cn: 把 say 与形近拼写以及其他言说动词作比较。

entries.definition: to kill in a violent way

normalIntro.en: Say is short, common, and changes sharply in the past tense.
normalIntro.cn: say 简短常用，过去式变化不规则。

normal.en: Say is one syllable, like the quick act of speaking.
normal.cn: say 是一个音节，正像说话这个快速动作。

normal.en: The past form said rhymes with red.
normal.cn: 过去式 said 与 red 押韵。

normal.en: Say hello and say goodbye are two daily phrases.
normal.cn: say hello 和 say goodbye 是两个日常短语。

normal.en: A saying is a short sentence people often repeat.
normal.cn: saying 是人们常重复的短句。

normal.en: Have a say means having a voice in a decision.
normal.cn: have a say 意为在决定中有发言权。

abstract.en: To say is to turn a thought into sound.
abstract.cn: 说就是把想法变成声音。

abstract.en: A word said today may echo for years.
abstract.cn: 今天说出的一句话可能回响多年。

abstract.en: Saying and listening are two halves of one conversation.
abstract.cn: 说与听是同一场对话的两半。

examples.en: What did she say about the meeting?
examples.cn: 她关于会议说了什么？

examples.en: The sign says no parking.
examples.cn: 牌子上写着禁止停车。

examples.en: Everyone will have a say in the final choice.
examples.cn: 每个人在最终选择中都会有发言权。

dict_mnemonic.text: say 是英语本族词，记 its 不规则变化：say, says, said；再记短语 have a say（有发言权）。

root: 源自古英语 secgan（说、告诉），属日耳曼语源，核心义「用话语表达」。

sensesIntro.en: Say means to speak, to show in writing, to give an example, or to have a right to speak.
sensesIntro.cn: say 意为说话、书面表明、举例说明，或拥有发言权。

core.en: To express something in words.
core.cn: 用话语表达某事。

branches.en: The core act of speaking words.
branches.cn: 说出话语的核心行为。

branches.en: Words on a sign or page speaking to readers.
branches.cn: 标牌或纸面上的文字向读者传达信息。

branches.en: A possible case stated aloud as an example.
branches.cn: 作为例子说出的可能情况。

branches.en: The right to make one's voice heard.
branches.cn: 让自己的声音被听见的权利。

branches.en: Spoken and written words both convey meaning.
branches.cn: 口头与书面文字都传递意义。

intro.en: Say forms several common compounds and derivatives.
intro.cn: say 构成若干常见复合词和派生词。

latinIntro.en: Say is Germanic rather than Latin, so the Latin entries list related concepts only.
latinIntro.cn: say 属日耳曼语而非拉丁语，因此拉丁条目只列相关概念。

items.exampleCN: 这个想法几乎难以表达。

items.example: No one can gainsay the facts.

items.meaning: a person who predicts the future

items.example: Some things are better left unsaid.

definition_en: the size or extent of something, a set of marks for measuring, or a thin plate on a fish
core_image: 地图角落的一小段比例尺，标注着图上距离与现实距离的关系
scene: 地图下方标着比例尺。A scale is printed at the bottom of the map.
sceneCN: 这里 scale 是「刻度；比例尺」（第 2 个义项）；句意：地图底部印着比例尺。

senses.title: Size and extent
senses.definition: the size or extent of something, especially when large
senses.definitionCN: 某事物的规模或范围，尤指较大规模
senses.example: The project was built on a huge scale.
senses.exampleCN: 这个项目以巨大的规模建成。
senses.why: The core abstract sense is how far something reaches.
senses.whyCN: 核心抽象义是事物所达到的范围。

senses.title: Measuring marks
senses.definition: a set of marks or numbers used for measuring
senses.definitionCN: 用于测量的一组刻度或数字
senses.example: Read the weight on the scale.
senses.exampleCN: 读出秤上的重量。
senses.why: A ladder of marks turns size into a readable measure.
senses.whyCN: 一串刻度把大小转化为可读的度量。

senses.title: Fish plate
senses.definition: one of the thin hard plates covering a fish or reptile
senses.definitionCN: 覆盖鱼或爬行动物身体的薄硬片
senses.example: The fish's scales shone in the light.
senses.exampleCN: 鱼鳞在光下闪闪发亮。
senses.why: The layered plates look like small measuring marks.
senses.whyCN: 层叠的薄片看起来像小刻度。

senses.title: Weighing device
senses.definition: a device with two pans for weighing, usually in the plural
senses.definitionCN: 通常用复数形式，指带两个秤盘的天平
senses.example: Place the fruit on the scales.
senses.exampleCN: 把水果放在秤上。
senses.why: The balanced beam is marked like a measuring scale.
senses.whyCN: 平衡的横梁像测量刻度一样被标记。

senses.title: Climb up
senses.definition: to climb up or over something steep
senses.definitionCN: 攀上或翻越陡峭之物
senses.example: They scaled the wall before dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在黎明前翻过了墙。
senses.why: Climbing a ladder resembles moving up a scale.
senses.whyCN: 爬梯子就像沿着刻度向上移动。

senses.title: Resize proportionally
senses.definition: to change the size of something while keeping its proportions
senses.definitionCN: 在保持比例的情况下改变某物的大小
senses.example: Scale the image to fit the page.
senses.exampleCN: 把图片缩放到适合页面。
senses.why: A scale keeps every part in the same ratio.
senses.whyCN: 比例尺让每个部分保持相同比率。

intro.en: Scale comes from Latin scala, a ladder or flight of steps.
intro.cn: scale 源自拉丁语 scala，意为梯子或一段台阶。

items.en: Scala means a ladder or a flight of steps.
items.cn: scala 意为梯子或一段台阶。

items.en: Scalae, the plural, named steps used for climbing.
items.cn: 复数 scalae 指用于攀爬的台阶。

items.en: Escale carried the sense of a ladder and a measure.
items.cn: escale 兼有梯子和度量之义。

items.en: Scale named a graduated measure and a climbing act.
items.cn: scale 指分级刻度和攀登动作。

items.en: The musical scale borrowed the ladder image.
items.cn: 音乐音阶借用了梯子的意象。

items.en: Scale extends to maps, models, and business size.
items.cn: 现代英语中 scale 扩展到地图、模型和商业规模。

note.en: Scale is compared with similar spellings and with words for size and measurement.
note.cn: 把 scale 与形近词以及表示大小和度量的词作比较。

entries.definition: the skin on the top of the head
a shellfish with a fan-shaped shell
the area or degree something covers
the limits between which something varies
a relationship between sizes or amounts

normalIntro.en: Scale can be remembered as a ladder of marks that measures many things.
normalIntro.cn: 可以把 scale 记成一串刻度阶梯，用来度量许多事物。

normal.en: A scale is a ladder of marks, from Latin scala.
normal.cn: scale 是一串刻度阶梯，源自拉丁语 scala。

normal.en: Fish scales overlap like the steps of a tiny ladder.
normal.cn: 鱼鳞层叠，就像微型梯子的台阶。

normal.en: Scale up means enlarge, scale down means reduce.
normal.cn: scale up 是扩大，scale down 是缩小。

normal.en: On a large scale means at a great size.
normal.cn: on a large scale 意为以巨大规模。

normal.en: The scales in a bathroom measure your weight.
normal.cn: 浴室的秤用来测量体重。

abstract.en: Every scale is a promise that size can be compared.
abstract.cn: 每一种刻度都意味着大小可以被比较。

abstract.en: A model keeps the scale but loses the weight.
abstract.cn: 模型保留比例，却失去了重量。

abstract.en: Climbing and measuring share the image of steps.
abstract.cn: 攀登与测量共享台阶的意象。

examples.en: The company expanded on an international scale.
examples.cn: 这家公司以国际规模扩张。

examples.en: The map has a scale of one to fifty thousand.
examples.cn: 这张地图的比例尺是一比五万。

examples.en: Workers scaled the cliff to reach the cave.
examples.cn: 工人们攀上悬崖到达洞穴。

dict_mnemonic.text: scale 源自「梯子」，梯子的台阶就是刻度；由此引申出规模、比例尺、音阶、鱼鳞和攀登。

root: 源自拉丁语 scala（梯子、台阶），核心义「一级一级的量度」，由此扩展到规模、刻度、比例与攀登。

sensesIntro.en: Scale means size, measuring marks, fish plates, a weighing device, climbing, or resizing.
sensesIntro.cn: scale 意为规模、刻度、鱼鳞、天平、攀登，或按比例缩放。

core.en: A ladder-like set of steps used to measure or climb.
core.cn: 像梯子一样用于度量或攀爬的一级级台阶。

branches.en: Measured size becomes the idea of scale.
branches.cn: 被度量的大小成为规模概念。

branches.en: The marks themselves form a measuring scale.
branches.cn: 刻度本身构成测量标尺。

branches.en: Overlapping plates resemble tiny steps.
branches.cn: 层叠的鳞片像微小的台阶。

branches.en: The weighing beam is marked like a scale.
branches.cn: 天平横梁像刻度尺一样被标记。

branches.en: Climbing up and scaling an image both follow a ratio.
branches.cn: 向上攀登与缩放图像都遵循某种比率。

intro.en: Scale has a productive family in measurement and technology.
intro.cn: scale 在度量与技术领域有能产的词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin scala, a ladder, is the source of the whole family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 scala（梯子）是整个词族的来源。

items.meaning: a weighing device or fish plates
the act of climbing or resizing
items.example: Scaling the wall took an hour.

items.meaning: able to grow or be resized

items.example: They tested the scalability of the app.
items.exampleCN: 他们测试了应用的可扩展性。

items.meaning: a device or program that resizes

items.example: They plan to scale up production.
We must scale down the design.
items.exampleCN: 我们必须缩小设计规模。

definition_en: a mark left on skin or feelings after a wound has healed
core_image: 手臂上一道淡白色的旧疤，记录着多年前的一次事故
scene: 事故多年后，他胳膊上仍有一道疤。A scar remains on his arm.
sceneCN: 这里 scar 是「伤疤」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他的胳膊上留着一道疤。

senses.title: Mark on skin
senses.definition: a mark left on the skin after a wound has healed
senses.definitionCN: 伤口愈合后留在皮肤上的痕迹
senses.example: The cut left a small scar on her knee.
senses.exampleCN: 那道割伤在她膝盖上留下了一个小疤。
senses.why: The core sense is the visible trace of healing.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是愈合留下的可见痕迹。

senses.title: Emotional wound
senses.definition: a lasting emotional hurt caused by a bad experience
senses.definitionCN: 糟糕经历造成的持久情感伤害
senses.example: The loss left deep scars on the family.
senses.exampleCN: 这次失去给这个家庭留下了深深的创伤。
senses.why: A mark on the mind mirrors a mark on the skin.
senses.whyCN: 心灵上的印记与皮肤上的印记相呼应。

senses.title: Leave a mark
senses.definition: to mark or damage someone or something permanently
senses.definitionCN: 永久地在某人或某物上留下痕迹或伤害
senses.example: The accident scarred him for life.
senses.exampleCN: 那场事故给他留下了终生的创伤。
senses.why: The noun becomes a verb for causing the mark.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为表示造成痕迹的动词。

intro.en: Scar comes through Old French from Latin eschara, a scab, and Greek eskhara.
intro.cn: scar 经古法语源自拉丁语 eschara（痂），更早来自希腊语 eskhara。

items.en: Eskhara meant a hearth or a scab.
items.cn: eskhara 意为炉灶或痂。

items.en: Eschara meant a scab or scar.
items.cn: eschara 意为痂或疤痕。

items.en: Escarre named a mark left by a wound.
items.cn: escarre 指伤口留下的痕迹。

items.en: Scarre entered English with the same meaning.
items.cn: scarre 以相同含义进入英语。

items.en: Scar extends from skin to emotions and landscapes.
items.cn: 现代英语中 scar 从皮肤扩展到情感与地貌。

note.en: Scar is compared with similar spellings and with words for wounds and marks.
note.cn: 把 scar 与形近词以及表示伤口和痕迹的词作比较。

entries.definition: a cloth worn around the neck
a small visible spot or line
a small mark that spoils appearance

normalIntro.en: Scar is a short word for a long-lasting mark.
normalIntro.cn: scar 是一个表示持久痕迹的短词。

normal.en: A scar is what a wound leaves behind.
normal.cn: 伤疤是伤口留下的东西。

normal.en: Scar and scare differ by one letter.
normal.cn: scar 与 scare 只差一个字母。

normal.en: The double r appears in scarred and scarring.
normal.cn: scarred 和 scarring 中都有双写 r。

normal.en: Scar tissue is the body's repair material.
normal.cn: 疤痕组织是身体的修复材料。

normal.en: Emotional scars are invisible but real.
normal.cn: 情感创伤看不见却是真实存在的。

abstract.en: A scar is proof that healing happened.
abstract.cn: 伤疤是愈合发生过的证明。

abstract.en: Some marks fade, while others become part of us.
abstract.cn: 有些痕迹会淡去，有些则成为我们的一部分。

abstract.en: The same word covers skin and memory.
abstract.cn: 同一个词既指皮肤也指记忆。

examples.en: The burn left a scar on his hand.
examples.cn: 烧伤在他手上留下了疤。

examples.en: Time can heal, but some scars remain.
examples.cn: 时间能治愈，但有些创伤仍在。

examples.en: The experience scarred her more than she admitted.
examples.cn: 这段经历给她的创伤比她承认的更深。

dict_mnemonic.text: scar 与 scare 形近；把「被吓到（scare）」和「留下疤（scar）」一起记：伤口会留下痕迹。

root: 经古法语 escarre 源自拉丁语 eschara（痂），更早为希腊语 eskhara，核心义「伤口愈合后留下的痕迹」。

sensesIntro.en: Scar means a mark on the skin, a lasting emotional hurt, or to leave such a mark.
sensesIntro.cn: scar 意为皮肤上的疤痕、持久的情感创伤，或留下这种痕迹。

core.en: A lasting mark left after healing.
core.cn: 愈合后留下的持久痕迹。

branches.en: The visible mark left on the skin.
branches.cn: 留在皮肤上的可见痕迹。

branches.en: An invisible mark left on feelings.
branches.cn: 留在情感上的无形痕迹。

branches.en: The act of leaving such a mark.
branches.cn: 留下这种痕迹的动作。

branches.en: Skin and mind both keep traces of injury.
branches.cn: 皮肤与心灵都会保留伤害的痕迹。

branches.en: A wound scars the body it damages.
branches.cn: 伤口会伤害并标记它所破坏的身体。

intro.en: Scar forms adjectives and nouns around healing and damage.
intro.cn: scar 围绕愈合与损伤构成形容词和名词。

latinIntro.en: Latin eschara and Greek eskhara, a scab, lie behind scar.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 eschara 与希腊语 eskhara（痂）是 scar 的来源。

items.meaning: a mark or to leave one

items.exampleCN: 疤痕形成可能是永久的。

items.example: Scar tissue replaced the damaged skin.
items.exampleCN: 疤痕组织替代了受损的皮肤。
这个孩子背负着情感创伤。

definition_en: a place where something happens, a part of a play or film, or a view
core_image: 警戒线围起的街角，警灯闪烁，路人远远围观
scene: 事故现场很快被警戒线围住。Police soon arrived at the scene of the accident.
sceneCN: 这里 scene 是「现场」（第 2 个义项）；句意：警察很快赶到事故现场。

senses.title: Part of a story
senses.definition: a part of a play, film, or book in which events happen in one place
senses.definitionCN: 戏剧、电影或书中在同一个地点发生事件的一段
senses.example: The opening scene takes place in a kitchen.
senses.exampleCN: 开场场景发生在一间厨房里。
senses.why: The core sense is a staged unit of action.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是一个被呈现的动作单元。

senses.title: Place of an event
senses.definition: the place where something, especially an accident or crime, happened
senses.definitionCN: 某事尤其事故或犯罪发生的地点
senses.example: Reporters rushed to the scene.
senses.exampleCN: 记者们赶到现场。
senses.why: The stage becomes the real place of action.
senses.whyCN: 舞台变成真实事件发生的地点。

senses.title: View of a place
senses.definition: a view of a place, especially a beautiful one
senses.definitionCN: 某地的景象，尤指美丽的景色
senses.example: The mountain scene was painted in soft colours.
senses.exampleCN: 山景被用柔和的色彩画了出来。
senses.why: A framed view resembles a stage set.
senses.whyCN: 被框住的景象就像舞台布景。

senses.title: Public outburst
senses.definition: a noisy or angry display in front of others
senses.definitionCN: 在他人面前吵闹或发怒的表现
senses.example: Please do not make a scene in the restaurant.
senses.exampleCN: 请不要在餐厅里当众吵闹。
senses.why: A public display is like a drama performed for others.
senses.whyCN: 当众表现就像为他人上演的戏剧。

senses.title: Social world
senses.definition: a particular area of activity or group of people
senses.definitionCN: 特定的活动领域或人群圈子
senses.example: She knows everyone in the music scene.
senses.exampleCN: 她认识音乐圈里的所有人。
senses.why: A social world is a stage with its own players.
senses.whyCN: 社交世界就是有自己演员的舞台。

intro.en: Scene comes from Greek skene, a tent or stage building, through Latin scaena.
intro.cn: scene 经拉丁语 scaena 源自希腊语 skene（帐篷、舞台建筑）。

items.en: Skene meant a tent or the stage building.
items.cn: skene 意为帐篷或舞台建筑。

items.en: Scaena named the stage and what appears on it.
items.cn: scaena 指舞台及舞台上的呈现。

items.en: Scene named a division of a play.
items.cn: scene 指戏剧的一个段落。

items.en: Scene entered English as a stage unit.
items.cn: scene 以舞台单元之义进入英语。

items.en: Scene extends to real places, views, and social worlds.
items.cn: 现代英语中 scene 扩展到真实地点、景色与社交圈。

note.en: Scene is compared with similar spellings and with words for setting and spectacle.
note.cn: 把 scene 与形近词以及表示场景和景象的词作比较。

entries.definition: what can be seen from a place

normalIntro.en: Scene began as the stage building and spread to every kind of setting.
normalIntro.cn: scene 起初指舞台建筑，后来扩展到各种场景。

normal.en: A scene is a picture with action inside it.
normal.cn: 场景就是一幅包含动作的画面。

normal.en: The scene of the crime is the place detectives study.
normal.cn: 犯罪现场是侦探研究的地点。

normal.en: Behind the scenes means out of public view.
normal.cn: behind the scenes 意为在公众视野之外。

normal.en: Make a scene means act out anger in public.
normal.cn: make a scene 意为当众发怒。

normal.en: The music scene is the world of musicians and fans.
normal.cn: 音乐圈就是音乐人和歌迷的世界。

abstract.en: Life is made of scenes, and memory keeps only some.
abstract.cn: 生活由一个个场景组成，记忆只留下其中一些。

abstract.en: Every public scene has an audience.
abstract.cn: 每一个公开场面都有观众。

abstract.en: A stage and a crime site share the same word.
abstract.cn: 舞台与犯罪现场共用一个词。

examples.en: The final scene of the film was silent.
examples.cn: 电影的最后一场是无声的。

examples.en: Photographers gathered at the scene.
examples.cn: 摄影师们聚集在现场。

examples.en: He made a scene when the order was wrong.
examples.cn: 订单出错时他当众发作了。

dict_mnemonic.text: scene 原指希腊戏剧的舞台建筑，舞台上的每一段是场景，舞台下的真实地点是现场。

root: 源自希腊语 skene（帐篷、舞台建筑），经拉丁语 scaena 入英语，核心义「呈现事件的场所或片段」。

sensesIntro.en: Scene means a unit of a story, the place of an event, a view, a public outburst, or a social world.
sensesIntro.cn: scene 意为故事场景、事件现场、景色、当众发作，或某个社交圈。

core.en: A stage-like place or unit where action happens.
core.cn: 像舞台一样承载动作的场所或单元。

branches.en: A staged unit of a play or film.
branches.cn: 戏剧或电影中的一段场景。

branches.en: The real place where an event happened.
branches.cn: 事件发生的真实地点。

branches.en: A view framed like a stage set.
branches.cn: 像舞台布景一样被框住的景色。

branches.en: An emotional display performed in public.
branches.cn: 在公众面前上演的情绪表演。

branches.en: A social world with its own players.
branches.cn: 有自己参与者的社交世界。

intro.en: Scene has a family of adjectives and stage-related nouns.
intro.cn: scene 有形容词和舞台相关名词构成的词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin scaena, the stage, is the direct source of scene.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 scaena（舞台）是 scene 的直接来源。

items.meaning: a place or unit of action
items.example: The scene is set at night.
The scenic road follows the coast.
items.exampleCN: 这条风景优美的路沿着海岸。
这个地区风景资源丰富。
舞台设计师搭建了布景。

items.example: Much work happens behind the scenes.
The crime scene was sealed off.

definition_en: a plan that lists times for events, or to arrange an event for a time
core_image: 秘书翻开日程本，把一个个会议填进格子里
scene: 秘书把会议加进了日程表。The secretary added the meeting to the schedule.
sceneCN: 这里 schedule 是「时间表」（第 1 个义项）；句意：秘书把会议加进了日程表。

senses.title: Timetable
senses.definition: a plan listing the times when events will happen
senses.definitionCN: 列出事件发生时间的计划
senses.example: My schedule is full this week.
senses.exampleCN: 我这周的日程排满了。
senses.why: The core sense is time laid out for events.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是为事件排布好的时间。

senses.title: Progress plan
senses.definition: a plan showing stages of work and when they should finish
senses.definitionCN: 显示工作阶段及其完成时间的计划
senses.example: The project is behind schedule.
senses.exampleCN: 这个项目落后于计划。
senses.why: A timetable for work becomes a progress plan.
senses.whyCN: 工作的时间表变成进度计划。

senses.title: Arrange a time
senses.definition: to arrange for something to happen at a particular time
senses.definitionCN: 安排某事在特定时间发生
senses.example: They scheduled the interview for Monday.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把面试安排在周一。
senses.why: The noun becomes the act of putting events in time.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为把事件放入时间中的动作。

senses.title: Detailed list
senses.definition: a formal list of items, prices, or conditions
senses.definitionCN: 物品、价格或条件的正式清单
senses.example: The contract includes a schedule of costs.
senses.exampleCN: 合同包含一份费用清单。
senses.why: An ordered sheet lists what belongs where.
senses.whyCN: 有序的表格列出什么归在哪里。

intro.en: Schedule comes from Late Latin schedula, a small sheet of paper.
intro.cn: schedule 源自晚期拉丁语 schedula（小纸片）。

items.en: Skhida meant a leaf of papyrus or a strip.
items.cn: skhida 意为纸莎草叶或纸条。

items.en: Scheda meant a sheet of paper.
items.cn: scheda 意为一张纸。

items.en: Schedula was a small written note.
items.cn: schedula 是一张小便条。

items.en: Cedule named a written list or label.
items.cn: cedule 指书面清单或标签。

items.en: Schedule meant a note or explanatory list.
items.cn: schedule 意为便条或说明性清单。

items.en: Schedule now means a timetable or to arrange.
items.cn: 现代英语中 schedule 指时间表或安排。

note.en: Schedule is compared with similar spellings and with words for plans.
note.cn: 把 schedule 与形近词以及表示计划的词作比较。

entries.definition: a list of times for events
a list of items for a meeting

normalIntro.en: Schedule began as a small sheet of paper holding a list.
normalIntro.cn: schedule 最初指写有清单的一小张纸。

normal.en: A schedule is a sheet that tells you when things happen.
normal.cn: 时间表是一张告诉你何时做什么的纸。

normal.en: On schedule means exactly on time.
normal.cn: on schedule 意为准时。

normal.en: Behind schedule means late, ahead of schedule means early.
normal.cn: behind schedule 是落后，ahead of schedule 是提前。

normal.en: The British say shed-yool, Americans say sked-jool.
normal.cn: 英式读 shed-yool，美式读 sked-jool。

normal.en: A busy schedule leaves little free time.
normal.cn: 繁忙的日程几乎没有空闲时间。

abstract.en: A schedule turns time into a shape we can manage.
abstract.cn: 时间表把时间变成可以管理的形状。

abstract.en: Plans fail when the schedule is only a wish.
abstract.cn: 当时间表只是愿望时，计划就会失败。

abstract.en: A small sheet of paper can rule a whole day.
abstract.cn: 一张小纸片可以支配一整天。

examples.en: The train arrived on schedule.
examples.cn: 火车准时到达。

examples.en: He scheduled a call for the afternoon.
examples.cn: 他安排下午通电话。

examples.en: The building work is ahead of schedule.
examples.cn: 建筑工程进度提前了。

dict_mnemonic.text: schedule 原指一张写有清单的小纸，后来指把时间排成清单，即日程表；动词即「安排」。

root: 源自晚期拉丁语 schedula（小纸片），经古法语 cedule 入英语，核心义「写有时间与事项的纸」。

sensesIntro.en: Schedule means a timetable, a progress plan, to arrange a time, or a detailed list.
sensesIntro.cn: schedule 意为时间表、进度表、安排时间，或明细清单。

core.en: A written sheet that orders events in time.
core.cn: 按时间排列事项的书面表格。

branches.en: The everyday timetable of events.
branches.cn: 日常事件的时间表。

branches.en: A plan for stages of work.
branches.cn: 工作阶段的计划。

branches.en: The act of setting a time.
branches.cn: 确定时间的动作。

branches.en: A formal list of items or costs.
branches.cn: 物品或费用的正式清单。

branches.en: The timetable and the act of arranging support each other.
branches.cn: 时间表与安排动作相互支撑。

intro.en: Schedule forms verbs and nouns about time management.
intro.cn: schedule 构成与时间管理有关的动词和名词。

latinIntro.en: Latin schedula, a small sheet, is the direct source.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 schedula（小纸片）是直接来源。

items.structure: English plural noun and third person form
items.meaningCN: 时间表（复数）；安排（第三人称）

items.exampleCN: 排日程是他的主要任务。

items.meaning: a person or program that schedules

definition_en: a plan for achieving something, or a secret and dishonest plot
core_image: 几个人在会议室角落低声交谈，桌上摊着一张利益地图
scene: 几个同事在暗地里密谋夺权。A few colleagues schemed to take over the department.
sceneCN: 这里 scheme 是「密谋；策划」（第 3 个义项）；句意：几个同事密谋接管这个部门。

senses.title: Organized plan
senses.definition: an official or organized plan for achieving something
senses.definitionCN: 为实现某事而制定的正式或有组织的计划
senses.example: The city launched a new recycling scheme.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市启动了一项新的回收计划。
senses.why: The core sense is an arranged outline of action.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是安排好的行动纲要。

senses.title: Secret plot
senses.definition: a secret plan to gain an advantage over others
senses.definitionCN: 为取得对他人优势而制定的秘密计划
senses.example: The scheme was discovered before it began.
senses.exampleCN: 这个阴谋在开始前就被发现了。
senses.why: A private plan turns dark when it harms others.
senses.whyCN: 当计划伤害他人时，私下的计划就变得阴暗。

senses.title: Plot secretly
senses.definition: to make secret plans, often to harm others
senses.definitionCN: 制定秘密计划，常指损害他人
senses.example: They schemed to win the contract.
senses.exampleCN: 他们密谋赢得合同。
senses.why: The noun becomes the act of plotting.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为密谋的动作。

senses.title: System or arrangement
senses.definition: an organized system such as a pension or benefit arrangement
senses.definitionCN: 如养老金或福利安排的有组织体系
senses.example: The pension scheme covers all staff.
senses.exampleCN: 养老金计划覆盖所有员工。
senses.why: A plan for many people becomes an institution.
senses.whyCN: 为许多人制定的计划变成一种制度。

intro.en: Scheme comes from Greek schema, a form or figure, through Latin schema.
intro.cn: scheme 经拉丁语 schema 源自希腊语 schema（形状、图形）。

items.en: Schema meant form, shape, or figure.
items.cn: schema 意为形式、形状或图形。

items.en: Schema meant a figure or a plan.
items.cn: schema 意为图形或计划。

items.en: Scheme entered English as a diagram or outline.
items.cn: scheme 以图表或纲要之义进入英语。

items.en: Scheme gained the sense of a secret plot.
items.cn: scheme 获得阴谋的含义。

items.en: Scheme covers official programmes and private plots.
items.cn: 现代英语中 scheme 兼指官方方案与私下阴谋。

note.en: Scheme is compared with similar spellings and with words for plans and plots.
note.cn: 把 scheme 与形近词以及表示计划和阴谋的词作比较。

entries.definition: a place or unit of action

normalIntro.en: Scheme began as a shape and became a plan drawn to that shape.
normalIntro.cn: scheme 最初指形状，后来指按那个形状画出的计划。

normal.en: A scheme is a plan with a clear outline.
normal.cn: 方案就是有清晰轮廓的计划。

normal.en: A pension scheme is an official plan.
normal.cn: pension scheme 是官方计划。

normal.en: A secret scheme is a plot.
normal.cn: 秘密的方案就是阴谋。

normal.en: To scheme against someone is to plot quietly.
normal.cn: scheme against someone 就是暗中算计某人。

normal.en: Schematic drawings show a plan in simple lines.
normal.cn: schematic 图用简单线条表示方案。

abstract.en: Every scheme is a shape imposed on the future.
abstract.cn: 每个方案都是强加给未来的一种形状。

abstract.en: A plan for everyone and a plot by a few share one word.
abstract.cn: 为众人的计划与少数人的阴谋共用一个词。

abstract.en: Schemes reveal what people want before they say it.
abstract.cn: 计谋在人开口之前就暴露了他们想要什么。

examples.en: The government introduced a training scheme.
examples.cn: 政府推出了一项培训方案。

examples.en: Two managers schemed to remove the director.
examples.cn: 两名经理密谋撤掉主管。

examples.en: Their scheme collapsed when the emails were leaked.
examples.cn: 邮件泄露后，他们的阴谋破产了。

dict_mnemonic.text: scheme 与 schema 同源，本义是「形状、图式」；把未来画成图就是方案，偷偷画的就是阴谋。

root: 源自希腊语 schema（形状、图式），经拉丁语 schema 入英语，核心义「为行动画出的轮廓」。

sensesIntro.en: Scheme means an official plan, a secret plot, to plot, or an organized system.
sensesIntro.cn: scheme 意为正式方案、秘密阴谋、密谋，或有组织的制度。

core.en: An outline drawn for future action.
core.cn: 为未来行动画出的轮廓。

branches.en: A public plan for achieving something.
branches.cn: 为实现某事而制定的公开计划。

branches.en: A hidden plan that harms others.
branches.cn: 损害他人的秘密计划。

branches.en: The act of making secret plans.
branches.cn: 制定秘密计划的动作。

branches.en: A plan that becomes a system for many people.
branches.cn: 成为许多人制度的计划。

branches.en: Public and secret plans share the same outline.
branches.cn: 公开计划与秘密计划共享同一轮廓。

intro.en: Scheme has a family of planners, plotters, and diagrams.
intro.cn: scheme 有规划者、阴谋者与图表构成的词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin schema, a form, is the direct source.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 schema（形状）是直接来源。

items.structure: English plural noun and third person form
items.meaningCN: 方案（复数）；密谋（第三人称）

items.exampleCN: 这个阴谋家终于被揭穿了。
各部件以示意图形式显示。
这个养老金计划很优厚。

definition_en: a place where children are taught, the time spent there, a group sharing ideas, or a group of fish
core_image: 清晨的校门口，学生背着书包鱼贯而入，上课铃正好响起
scene: 孩子们背上书包，一起去学校。The children put on their backpacks and went to school together.
sceneCN: 这里 school 是「学校」（第 1 个义项）；句意：孩子们背上书包，一起去学校。

senses.title: A place of teaching
senses.definition: a place where children or students are taught
senses.definitionCN: 教育儿童或学生的场所
senses.example: The school opens at eight.
senses.exampleCN: 学校八点开门。
senses.why: The central modern sense is the building and institution.
senses.whyCN: 核心现代义是建筑与教育机构。

senses.title: Time spent studying
senses.definition: the time or activity of being taught
senses.definitionCN: 接受教育的时间或活动
senses.example: School starts at eight in the morning.
senses.exampleCN: 上午八点开始上课。
senses.why: The place sense extends to the activity that happens there.
senses.whyCN: 场所义延伸到在那里进行的活动。

senses.title: A group sharing ideas
senses.definition: a group of people with shared ideas or methods
senses.definitionCN: 拥有共同思想或方法的一群人
senses.example: She belongs to a school of modern painters.
senses.exampleCN: 她属于一个现代画家流派。
senses.why: A school of thought is a community taught by shared ideas.
senses.whyCN: 思想学派是由共同观念维系的群体。

senses.title: A group of fish
senses.definition: a large group of fish swimming together
senses.definitionCN: 一起游动的一大群鱼
senses.example: A school of fish passed the reef.
senses.exampleCN: 一群鱼游过了礁石。
senses.why: The sense comes from a separate old word for a crowd.
senses.whyCN: 这一义项来自另一个表示群体的古老词。

intro.en: School comes from Greek skholē, leisure, through Latin schola.
intro.cn: school 源自希腊语 skholē（闲暇），经拉丁语 schola 传入英语。

items.en: Skholē meant leisure or free time used for discussion.
items.cn: skholē 意为闲暇或用于讨论的空闲时间。

items.en: Schola meant a place of learned discussion.
items.cn: schola 意为进行学术讨论的场所。

items.en: Scol meant a place of instruction.
items.cn: scol 意为教学场所。

items.en: School covered both the place and the activity of learning.
items.cn: school 同时指场所与学习活动。

items.en: School also means a school of thought or a group of fish.
items.cn: 现代英语中 school 还指学派或鱼群。

note.en: School is compared with similar-looking words and with words for places of learning.
note.cn: 把 school 与形近词以及表示学习场所的词作比较。

entries.definition: a school or society for study
an organization for study or research

normalIntro.en: School is the place, schooling is the experience, and scholar is the person.
normalIntro.cn: school 是场所，schooling 是经历，scholar 是人。

normal.en: Go to school takes no article before school.
normal.cn: go to school 中 school 前不加冠词。

normal.en: A school of fish swims as one group.
normal.cn: a school of fish 指一群一起游动的鱼。

normal.en: A school of thought is a shared set of ideas.
normal.cn: school of thought 指共享的一套思想。

normal.en: Scholar and school share a Greek root.
normal.cn: scholar 与 school 共享希腊词根。

normal.en: Schooling means the education received at school.
normal.cn: schooling 意为在学校接受的教育。

abstract.en: School began as leisure, because learning needed free time.
abstract.cn: school 最初与闲暇有关，因为学习需要空闲时间。

abstract.en: A place, an activity, and a community all share one word.
abstract.cn: 场所、活动与群体共用一个词。

abstract.en: Even a group of fish is a kind of crowd.
abstract.cn: 连鱼群也是一种群体。

examples.en: She teaches at a village school.
examples.cn: 她在一所乡村学校教书。

examples.en: We have no school during the holiday.
examples.cn: 假期里我们不上课。

examples.en: The two writers belong to the same school.
examples.cn: 这两位作家属于同一个流派。

dict_mnemonic.text: school 源自希腊语 skholē（闲暇、讨论），古人把闲暇用于学习讨论，词义后来变成「学校」。

root: 源自希腊语 skholē（闲暇、讲学），经拉丁语 schola，核心义「用于学习讨论的场所与活动」。

sensesIntro.en: School means a place of teaching, the time spent studying, a group with shared ideas, or a group of fish.
sensesIntro.cn: school 意为教学场所、上学时间、思想流派，或鱼群。

core.en: A place and activity organized around learning.
core.cn: 围绕学习组织起来的场所与活动。

branches.en: The building where students learn.
branches.cn: 学生学习所在的建筑。

branches.en: The activity and time of being taught.
branches.cn: 接受教育的活动与时间。

branches.en: A community of shared thought.
branches.cn: 共享思想的群体。

branches.en: A crowd of fish moving together.
branches.cn: 一起移动的鱼群。

branches.en: The place and the schedule of study depend on each other.
branches.cn: 场所与学习安排相互依存。

intro.en: School forms words for students, teaching, and school buildings.
intro.cn: school 构成表示学生、教学与校舍的词汇。

latinIntro.en: Latin schola and Greek skholē are the sources.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 schola 与希腊语 skholē 是词源。

items.example: The school is near the park.

items.exampleCN: 他受过很少的学校教育。

items.meaning: a boy who goes to school
items.example: The schoolboy ran to catch the bus.
items.exampleCN: 男学生跑着去赶公交车。

items.meaning: a girl who goes to school
items.example: The schoolgirl carried a red bag.
items.exampleCN: 女学生背着一个红色书包。

items.example: Her schoolbag is full of books.

items.meaning: a building used as a school

definition_en: the systematic study of the physical world, the knowledge gained from it, or a particular field of such study
core_image: 实验室里，试管排成一列，屏幕上跳动着刚记录的数据
scene: 他翻开课本，想弄明白实验背后的道理。Science explains how the experiment works.
sceneCN: 这里 science 是「科学」（第 1 个义项）；句意：科学解释了实验如何运作。

senses.title: Systematic knowledge
senses.definition: the organized study of the physical world through observation and experiment
senses.definitionCN: 通过观察和实验对物质世界进行的有系统研究
senses.example: Science has changed daily life.
senses.exampleCN: 科学改变了日常生活。
senses.why: The central sense is organized knowledge of nature.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是关于自然的有组织知识。

senses.title: Scientific activity
senses.definition: the work of doing scientific research
senses.definitionCN: 进行科学研究的工作
senses.example: Science needs patience and honesty.
senses.exampleCN: 科学研究需要耐心与诚实。
senses.why: The knowledge sense extends to the activity that produces it.
senses.whyCN: 知识义延伸到产生知识的研究活动。

senses.title: A field of study
senses.definition: a particular branch of systematic study
senses.definitionCN: 系统研究的某个分支
senses.example: She studies computer science.
senses.exampleCN: 她学习计算机科学。
senses.why: A broad method narrows to one named discipline.
senses.whyCN: 宽泛的方法缩小为一个具体学科。

intro.en: Science comes from Latin scientia, knowledge, from scire, to know.
intro.cn: science 源自拉丁语 scientia（知识），来自 scire（知道）。

items.en: Scire meant to know.
items.cn: scire 意为知道。

items.en: Scientia meant knowledge or understanding.
items.cn: scientia 意为知识或理解。

items.en: Science meant knowledge of any kind.
items.cn: science 意为任何类型的知识。

items.en: Science narrowed to knowledge based on observation.
items.cn: science 缩小为基于观察的知识。

items.en: Science now names the study of the natural world.
items.cn: 现代英语中 science 指对自然世界的研究。

note.en: Science is compared with similar-looking words and with words for knowledge and study.
note.cn: 把 science 与形近词以及表示知识与研究的词作比较。

entries.definition: a sense of right and wrong

normalIntro.en: Science is knowledge, scientific is the adjective, and scientist is the person.
normalIntro.cn: science 是知识，scientific 是形容词，scientist 是人。

normal.en: Science fiction mixes science with imagination.
normal.cn: 科幻小说把科学与想象结合。

normal.en: Computer science is the study of computing.
normal.cn: 计算机科学是研究计算的学科。

normal.en: A science lab is where experiments happen.
normal.cn: 科学实验室是做实验的地方。

normal.en: Science and scientist share the same base.
normal.cn: science 与 scientist 同根。

normal.en: The ence ending marks a noun.
normal.cn: ence 结尾提示这是名词。

abstract.en: Science began as knowledge in general, then narrowed to tested knowledge.
abstract.cn: science 起初泛指知识，后来缩小为经过检验的知识。

abstract.en: The word links a method, a body of knowledge, and a field.
abstract.cn: 这个词连接方法、知识体系与学科。

abstract.en: To know is the heart of science.
abstract.cn: 「知道」是 science 的核心。

examples.en: Science has changed daily life.
examples.cn: 科学改变了日常生活。

examples.en: She studies computer science.
examples.cn: 她学习计算机科学。

examples.en: The science of medicine grows fast.
examples.cn: 医学科学发展得很快。

dict_mnemonic.text: science 源自拉丁语 scire（知道），ence 构成名词，所以 science 就是「系统化的知识」。

root: 源自拉丁语 scientia（知识），来自 scire（知道），核心义「经系统研究获得的知识」。

sensesIntro.en: Science means systematic knowledge, the activity of research, or a particular field of study.
sensesIntro.cn: science 意为系统知识、研究活动，或某个学科。

core.en: Knowledge built by observation and testing.
core.cn: 通过观察与检验建立的知识。

branches.en: Organized knowledge of nature.
branches.cn: 关于自然的有组织知识。

branches.en: The work of testing and discovering.
branches.cn: 检验与发现的工作。

branches.en: One named branch such as chemistry.
branches.cn: 像化学这样的具体学科。

branches.en: Knowledge and research depend on each other.
branches.cn: 知识与研究相互依存。

branches.en: Each discipline has its own methods.
branches.cn: 每个学科都有自己的方法。

intro.en: Science forms words for its method, people, and fields.
intro.cn: science 构成表示方法、人物与学科的词汇。

latinIntro.en: Latin scientia and scire are the sources.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 scientia 与 scire 是词源。

items.exampleCN: 这所学校教授多门科学。
科学家们分享研究结果。
这个说法经过了科学检验。
计算机科学吸引许多学生。

items.meaning: the study of people and society
items.exampleCN: 社会科学研究人类群体。

definition_zh: 科学的；科学研究的；严谨系统的
definition_en: relating to science or its methods, or careful and systematic in approach
core_image: 研究者戴着护目镜，把样本放进仪器，旁边的记录表写得整整齐齐
scene: 研究团队用科学的方法检验这个说法。The team used a scientific method to test the claim.
sceneCN: 这里 scientific 是「科学的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：研究团队用科学的方法检验这个说法。

senses.title: Relating to science
senses.definition: connected with science or the work of scientists
senses.definitionCN: 与科学或科学家的工作有关的
senses.example: They need scientific evidence.
senses.exampleCN: 他们需要科学证据。
senses.why: The main sense points to the field of science.
senses.whyCN: 主要义项指向科学领域。

senses.title: Careful and systematic
senses.definition: done in a careful, organized, and testable way
senses.definitionCN: 以谨慎、有条理且可检验的方式进行的
senses.example: Her approach is scientific and careful.
senses.exampleCN: 她的方法严谨而细致。
senses.why: The method of science becomes a general style of thinking.
senses.whyCN: 科学方法变成一种普遍的思维方式。

senses.title: Used in science
senses.definition: designed or used for scientific work
senses.definitionCN: 为科学工作设计或使用的
senses.example: The lab bought scientific instruments.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室购买了科学仪器。
senses.why: Objects and tools take the label of the field they serve.
senses.whyCN: 物品与工具以所服务领域的名称来命名。

intro.en: Scientific combines Latin scientia, knowledge, with the ending fic, making.
intro.cn: scientific 由拉丁语 scientia（知识）与表示「造成」的结尾 fic 组合而成。

items.en: Scientia meant knowledge.
items.cn: scientia 意为知识。

items.en: Scientificus meant producing knowledge.
items.cn: scientificus 意为产生知识的。

items.en: Scientific entered English meaning producing knowledge.
items.cn: scientific 进入英语时意为产生知识的。

items.en: It came to mean relating to science.
items.cn: 它开始表示与科学有关的。

items.en: Scientific also means systematic and careful.
items.cn: 现代英语中 scientific 还表示系统严谨的。

note.en: Scientific is compared with related forms and with adjectives for careful inquiry.
note.cn: 把 scientific 与相关词形以及表示严谨探究的形容词作比较。

entries.definition: done according to a clear plan

normalIntro.en: Scientific is the adjective of science, formed with the ending fic.
normalIntro.cn: scientific 是 science 的形容词，由结尾 fic 构成。

normal.en: Scientific method is a careful way to test ideas.
normal.cn: 科学方法是检验想法的严谨方式。

normal.en: Scientific evidence supports a claim.
normal.cn: 科学证据支持某个说法。

normal.en: The scientific community shares results.
normal.cn: 科学界共享研究结果。

normal.en: Unscientific means not based on science.
normal.cn: unscientific 意为不科学的。

normal.en: Scientific and science share the sci base.
normal.cn: scientific 与 science 共享 sci 词干。

abstract.en: The ending fic means making, so scientific once meant knowledge-making.
abstract.cn: 结尾 fic 意为造成，因此 scientific 原意为「产生知识的」。

abstract.en: Science as a method becomes an adjective for any careful work.
abstract.cn: 科学作为一种方法，其形容词可形容任何严谨工作。

abstract.en: To call work scientific is to demand evidence.
abstract.cn: 称一项工作为科学的，就是要求证据。

examples.en: They need scientific evidence.
examples.cn: 他们需要科学证据。

examples.en: The claim has no scientific basis.
examples.cn: 这个说法没有科学依据。

examples.en: The lab bought scientific instruments.
examples.cn: 实验室购买了科学仪器。

dict_mnemonic.text: science 是「知识、科学」，fic 表示「产生……的」，scientific 就是「产生科学知识的、科学的」。

root: 由 science（科学）加后缀 fic（产生……的）构成，远源为拉丁语 scientia（知识）与 facere（做）。

sensesIntro.en: Scientific means relating to science, careful and systematic, or used for scientific work.
sensesIntro.cn: scientific 意为与科学有关的、严谨系统的，或用于科学工作的。

core.en: Marked by the methods and standards of science.
core.cn: 具有科学方法与标准的。

branches.en: Connected with the field of science.
branches.cn: 与科学领域相关。

branches.en: Done with care, order, and tests.
branches.cn: 以谨慎、条理与检验完成。

branches.en: Tools made for research work.
branches.cn: 为研究工作制造的器具。

branches.en: The field and its method reinforce each other.
branches.cn: 领域与方法相互强化。

branches.en: Instruments serve careful inquiry.
branches.cn: 仪器服务于严谨探究。

intro.en: Scientific joins the science family of knowledge words.
intro.cn: scientific 加入由知识词汇构成的 science 词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin scientificus is the direct model.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 scientificus 是直接构词模型。

items.meaning: the group of scientists as a whole
items.example: The scientific community welcomed the result.
